strings.name: Bengt Holmström
strings.summary: Holmström studies information asymmetry, incentives, teams and liquidity, asking how firms design rewards when actions are hard to observe. Collaborating with Milgrom, Tirole and others, he taught at Northwestern, Yale and MIT. He shared the 2016 economics prize with Hart, became MIT emeritus and was elected to the US National Academy of Sciences in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Studied incentive contracts and information within organizations, influencing corporate compensation, governance and financial-intermediation theory.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Bachelor’s, Helsinki(1972); MS in operations research, Stanford(1975); PhD(1978).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Incentive contracts
strings.highlights.h1.text: Studied moral hazard, teams and multitasking, explaining trade-offs in pay and organizations.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Liquidity and finance
strings.highlights.h2.text: With Tirole, analyzed financial intermediation, corporate finance and liquidity provision.
strings.timeline.t1.title: National Academy of Sciences
strings.timeline.t2.title: Economics prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the award with Oliver Hart for contract theory.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Inside and Outside Liquidity
strings.timeline.t3.text: Co-authored a book on financial liquidity with Jean Tirole.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joined MIT
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved to MIT to continue incentive and organizational research.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Multitask incentives
strings.timeline.t5.text: Published a multitask principal–agent model with Paul Milgrom.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Yale faculty
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from Northwestern to Yale’s management school.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Moral hazard
strings.timeline.t7.text: Published the influential paper on moral hazard and observability.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Stanford doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed his PhD, moving from operations research toward organizational incentives.
